traits: Mud Spray. The toad can use this ability once per turn. It releases a cloud of mud in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

name: Mottled Toad
actions: Toad Claws. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
traits: Mud Shield. The toad can use this ability once per turn. It creates a protective layer of mud that grants it resistance to bludgeoning damage until the start of its next turn.

name: Miremaw
actions:
Toad Claws. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

Mud Burst (Recharge 5-6). The miremaw releases a cloud of mud in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 15 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.
lair_actions: Lair action: Mud Torrent. The miremaw releases a torrent of mud in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be restrained and take 20 (4d6) bludgeoning damage.

name: Scavenger Rat
actions: Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
traits: Scent. The rat can detect the direction of any creature that is within 30 feet of it that has a different alignment than it.

name: Tunneling Rat
actions: Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4) piercing damage.
traits: Burrow. The rat can burrow through dirt, stone, or concrete, moving through it at half speed.

name: Flesh-Eater Rat
actions: Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6) piercing damage.
traits: Rotting Bite. If the rat hits a creature with its claw attack, it can deal an additional 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

name: The Rotting King
actions:
Maw of Decay. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be infected by the Rot. The infected creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls until the end of its turn.

Spore Cloud (recharge 5-6). The rotting king exhales a cloud of spores in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet.
lair_actions: Lair action: Spore Burst. The rotting king releases a spore burst in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet.

name: Common Cockroach
actions: Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
traits: Swarm traits: When a creature is reduced to 0 HP by the swarm, it is considered to have been slain by the swarm. The swarm can occupy the same space as a creature.
